newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Ocean City, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Ocean City, N.J..

text.p: The Board of Education of The City of Ocean City
Book Entry Bonds, Bank Qualified, Noncallable

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Board Secretary of the Board of Education at the Administrative Offices of the Board of Education, 801 Asbury Avenue, Ocean City, New Jersey 08226 on October 23, 1996 until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the above Bonds of the School District dated November 1, 1996 and due (without option of prior

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are not subject to redemption prior to their stated maturities. The Board will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon & Scotland, Newark, N.J.

The Bonds will bear interest at a single rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable semiannually on February 1 and August 1 in each year until maturity, commencing on August 1, 1997. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale.
The full Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting Doris J. Hitchner, the Board Secretary at 801 Asbury Avenue, Ocean City, New Jersey 08226 (609) 399-4161.
